solutionSql:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       c.name AS customer_name,
       COUNT(s.id) FILTER (WHERE i.id IS NULL)::integer AS unbilled_shipments
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN shipments s ON s.customer_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.shipment_id = s.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;
notes: The starter's only defect is COUNT(*), which counts the NULL placeholder row for customers 7 and 8. Counting s.id fixes it. The sample total of 35 unbilled shipments matches 240 shipments minus 205 invoices, and the output sums to 35.
